title: 09 / Membrane
sub: A shaman strikes a great drum, and time falls away to a hundredth as the beater lands. Rings crawl across the hide, then the membrane of our universe ripples and opens onto the worlds beyond it. A seamless 26-second loop in WebGPU, the drum's sound simulated from its own physics.

title: 04 / Gyre
sub: Forty glazed hoops, each one flipping over twice a loop, starting from the outside. A seamless 16-second loop, sphere-traced in WebGPU.
